propositions: max_consecutive_repeat metric only detects adjacent identical signatures and scores k-cycles (k >= 2) as 1, missing actual loops while scoring healthy breadth-first runs higher

a windowed distinct-ratio over trailing 24 tool-call signatures (cardinality divided by window size) is order-insensitive and fires on all cycle lengths; real loops show ratio <= 0.50 while healthy runs stay above 0.833
the new distinct_ratio_window field must be added to _repetition_summary output as None when fewer than 24 signatures exist, preventing false positives on short runs
module constants REPETITION_WINDOW=24 and REPETITION_TRIP_RATIO=0.50 must be exported and shared across three consumers (usage_log, actuator c827, recorder aec1) for consistency
existing counters and privacy contract (hashed arguments) must remain unchanged; the new signal is additive and all current tests must pass unmodified
